journey.name: Deck management — edit metadata and delete with confirmation
journey.description: Owner-only deck actions on the deck from journey 02: edit entry point, then full deletion with confirmation (homeserver cleanup). Run after journeys 02 and 03.

actions.action: Launch the Echo app and open the Decks tab
Verify the deck detail screen shows Edit and Delete controls (owner view)
Verify a confirmation dialog appears mentioning the deck will be removed from the homeserver
Cancel the dialog and verify the deck detail screen is still shown
Tap the Delete control again and confirm the deletion
Verify the app navigates back and "Animals PT" no longer appears in the Decks list
